1111.title: Adamant chainbody
1111.wikitext:
{{External|rsc=Adamantite Chain Mail Body|rs}} {{Infobox Item |name = Adamant chainbody |image = [[File:Adamant chainbody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A series of connected metal rings. |value = 4800 |weight = 7.711 |exchange = Yes |id = 1111 }} [[File:Adamant chainbody detail.png|120px|left]] '''Adamant chainbody''' is piece of [[armour]] made from [[adamant equipment|adamantite]]. A player can create an adamant chainbody by using an [[adamant bar|adamantite bar]] on an [[anvil]] while a [[hammer]] and 3 adamantite bars are in the player's inventory. A [[Smithing]] level of 81 is required to make an adamant chainbody and doing so will grant the player 187.5 Smithing experience. Level 30 [[Defence]] is required to wear an adamant chainbody. It can also be bought from [[Wayne's Chains]] in south [[Falador]]. One adamant chainbody is required for [[Song of the Elves]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -15 |arange = 0 |dstab = +36 |dslash = +50 |dcrush = +61 |dmagic = -3 |drange = +38 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Adamant chainbody equipped male.png]] |altimage = [[File:Adamant chainbody equipped female.png|150px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 81 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 187.5 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Adamantite bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Adamant chainbody }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Adamant chainbody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Adamant chainbody}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Adamant chainbody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2006 |update = Rag and Bone Man |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 17 – 24 November 2004 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Adamant chainbody detail (historical, v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody detail (historical, v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Adamant chainbody (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody.png|center]] |- |[[File:Adamant chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Adamant chainbody equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |29 March 2004 –

1107.title: Black chainbody
1107.wikitext:
{{External|rs|rsc=Black Chain Mail Body}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black chainbody |image = [[File:Black chainbody.png]] |release = [[8 December]] [[2001]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (8 December 2001) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A series of connected metal rings. |value = 1440 |weight = 6.803 |exchange = Yes |id = 1107 }} [[File:Black chainbody detail.png|120px|left]] The '''black chainbody''' is stronger than the [[steel chainbody]], and can be worn by players with 10 [[Defence]]. Players can purchase this item at the [[Keldagrim]] and [[Falador]] [[Chainmail shops]]. This item cannot be made using the [[Smithing]] skill, and has the same bonuses as a [[white chainbody]], except it lacks a [[prayer bonus]]. Sold at [[Wayne's Chains]] shop in southern Falador for 1,440 coins, and at [[Saro]]'s armour shop in Keldagrim for 1,872 coins. As with all [[Black equipment|black]] and [[white equipment]], the black chainbody cannot be made from raw materials using the [[Smithing]] skill. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -15 |arange = 0 |dstab = +22 |dslash = +32 |dcrush = +39 |dmagic = -3 |drange = +24 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Black chainbody equipped male.png]] |altimage = [[File:Black chainbody equipped female.png]] }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black chainbody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black chainbody}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Black chainbody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2006 |update = Rag and Bone Man |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 17 – 24 November 2004 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black chainbody detail (historical, v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black chainbody detail (historical, v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black chainbody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black chainbody (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Black chainbody (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Black chainbody.png|center]] |- |[[File:Black chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Black chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Black chainbody equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |29 March 2004 –

1103.wikitext:
{{External|rs|rsc=Bronze Chain Mail Body}} {{Infobox Item |name = Bronze chainbody |image = [[File:Bronze chainbody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A series of connected metal rings. |value = 60 |weight = 6.803 |respawn = 700 |exchange = Yes |id = 1103 }} [[File:Bronze chainbody detail.png|120px|left]] The '''bronze chainbody''' is a chainbody that can be made at an anvil with 3 [[bronze bar]]s and a hammer with a [[Smithing]] level of 11, granting 37.5 Smithing experience. 1109.title: Mithril chainbody
1109.wikitext:
{{External|rs|rsc=Mithril_Chain_Mail_Body}} {{Infobox Item |name = Mithril chainbody |image = [[File:Mithril chainbody.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A series of connected metal rings. |value = 1950 |weight = 5.896 |exchange = Yes |id = 1109 }} [[File:Mithril chainbody detail.png|120px|left]] The '''Mithril chainbody''' is a [[chainbody]] made out of [[mithril equipment|mithril]]. As with all mithril armour, it requires 20 [[Defence]] to wear. Like all chainbodies, it provides better Crush defence than a [[Mithril platebody|platebody]] made of the same material, at the cost of lower Stab and Slash defence. The Mithril chainbody can be made with level 61 [[Smithing]] using 3 [[mithril bar]]s, and grants 150 Smithing experience. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -15 |arange = 0 |dstab = +25 |dslash = +35 |dcrush = +42 |dmagic = -3 |drange = +27 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Mithril chainbody equipped male.png|130px]] |altimage = [[File:Mithril chainbody equipped female.png|150px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 61 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 150 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Mithril bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Mithril chainbody }} ==Treasure Trails== {{EmoteClue}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Mithril chainbody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Mithril chainbody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2006 |update = Rag and Bone Man |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 17 – 24 November 2004 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Mithril chainbody detail (historical, v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody detail (historical, v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Mithril chainbody (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody.png|center]] |- |[[File:Mithril chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Mithril chainbody equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |29 March 2004 –

1113.title: Rune chainbody
1113.wikitext:
{{External|rs|rsc=Rune Chain Mail Body}} {{Infobox Item |name = Rune chainbody |image = [[File:Rune chainbody.png]] |release = [[26 July]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape updated (26 July 2001) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = A series of connected metal rings. |value = 50000 |weight = 6.803 |exchange = Yes |id = 1113 }} [[File:Rune chainbody detail.png|120px|left]] A '''rune chainbody''' is a [[chainbody]] made of [[Rune equipment|runite]]. To wear this chainbody, a player needs at least level 40 [[Defence]]. This piece of body armour is less resistant than the [[rune platebody]] in all stats except [[Crush weapons|crush]] and [[magic]] and wearing it does not require completion of [[Dragon Slayer I]]. For this reason it is commonly worn by players who have not finished said quest or who are fighting against [[monster]]s that use crush attacks. It is also useful for rangers since it has higher defence bonuses than the [[green d'hide body]] and it does not penalise ranged attack. A player with 96 [[Smithing]] can make the chainbody by using three [[runite bar]]s on an [[anvil]], granting 225 Smithing [[experience]]. It can also be bought at [[Scavvo's Rune Store]] in the [[Champions' Guild]], or for [[members]], at [[Seddu's Adventurer's Store]] in [[Nardah]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -15 |arange = 0 |dstab = +63 |dslash = +72 |dcrush = +78 |dmagic = -3 |drange = +65 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = body |image = [[File:Rune chainbody equipped male.png]] |altimage = [[File:Rune chainbody equipped female.png]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |skill1 = Smithing |skill1lvl = 96 |skill1boostable = Yes |skill1exp = 225 |members = No |ticks = 5 |tools = Hammer |facilities = Anvil |mat1 = Runite bar |mat1quantity = 3 |output1 = Rune chainbody }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Rune chainbody}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Rune chainbody}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 10 April 2006 |update = Rag and Bone Man |change = *The item was graphically updated. *The item's equip model was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 17 – 24 November 2004 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Rune chainbody detail (historical, v1).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Rune chainbody detail (historical, v2).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Rune chainbody detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Rune chainbody (historical, v1).png|center]] |[[File:Rune chainbody (historical, v2).png|center]] |[[File:Rune chainbody.png|center]] |- |[[File:Rune chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Rune chainbody equipped male (historical).png|center|300x300px]] |[[File:Rune chainbody equipped male.png|center|300x300px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
